mostWorthwhile.text: Building the epidermal barrier was most worthwhile: the planned image and prose connect the lipids and outer cells to reduced water loss and explain how deeper cells replace those shed.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the sweat gland was the least informative moment: the fitting itself added no explanation of the gland's function.

surprise.text: The completed skin brought the gland, vessels and nerves together in one description, making their different roles clearer.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, although assembling the sweat gland did not explain what sweat does.

continue.text: I would not personally continue on this evidence: the barrier and renewal explanation was useful, but several fittings were predictable and added little on their own.
